what: hello (/Volumes/Projects/.coord-1030/hello, b2-build/hello3-run.log 20:13, blaze built from the shared tree at 20:12) now stops at std's own build scripts: `build-script-build` of compiler_builtins, libc, object and std each fail with `blaze-items: Fn build_script_build::main has no hash: MIR that failed to lower`. Their crates have no dependencies at all: `crates/blaze-units/src/load/units.rs::merge_std` attaches std's roots only to the units before `offset` (the workspace's), and request 00710 says by design that std's build-script units are host units with no edge to std roots, and that how one links a std is the daemon's (blaze-wasi's std, as v1). Nothing in v2 does that yet (no wasi std, no host std for these units), so std can never build and no program builds. Needs the owner's design: which std these four scripts resolve, compile and link against (a host std graph is a cycle through their runs; v1 used blaze-wasi's std).
